svg.title: Instrument noise of GRACE-type gravity missions
svg.text: Instrument noise of GRACE-type gravity missions
Amplitude spectral density, m s⁻² Hz⁻¹ᐟ², along the inter-satellite line of sight. Reproduces Zingerle et al. (2024), Fig. 1, from its eqs. 1–8.
Corresponding spherical-harmonic degree, n ≈ f·T (463 km orbit, T = 5620 s)
a · Accelerometers, ×√2 for the two satellites
b · Laser ranging, as range acceleration (2πf)²·ASD
c · Combined line-of-sight noise per mission class
CAI accelerometers are drawn to 0.03 Hz, as in the paper. The CAI11/CAI12 classes use the CAI white level throughout: the paper's EA–CAI fusion is not published.
